clauses.heading: 8. Limitation on Liability
clauses.text: Each party's liability under this Agreement shall be unlimited.

clauses.heading: 10. Indemnification
clauses.text: The Company shall indemnify Institution for any and all claims, without limit.

issues.counterparty_change_summary: Counterparty removed the liability cap from Section 8.
issues.external_rationale_for_footnote: Section 8 must retain the standard aggregate liability cap.
issues.proposed_replacement_text: $150,000 mutual aggregate liability cap; mutual exclusion of consequential, special, punitive, incidental, and indirect damages; no implied warranties beyond those expressly set forth.
issues.source_quote: Each party's liability under this Agreement shall be unlimited.

issues.counterparty_change_summary: Counterparty introduced one-way indemnification of Institution by the Company.
issues.external_rationale_for_footnote: One-way indemnification by the Company is not an acceptable position.
issues.proposed_replacement_text: Neither party shall bear responsibility for defending or compensating the other party for third-party claims arising under this Agreement, except as expressly and narrowly set forth in Section 8.
issues.source_quote: The Company shall indemnify Institution for any and all claims, without limit.

primary.verdict_summary: Two issues identified requiring attention before your organization can accept this draft.
